completeOriginalProcedureUnchanged: KEEP Action,60feet and meaningful information about ONE legendary person,place or thing. NEW select the actual subject if perceived within60feet/line of effect,or one genuine known reference to it physically present within60feet/line of effect,such as an established named historical account,accurate depiction or authentic associated relic. This explicit reference-anchor mode permits inquiry about a remote subject without turning an arbitrary guessed name into a hidden-target search. The reference must identify one actual subject,not an invented category or ambiguous collection; hidden inauthenticity/ambiguity yields Indeterminate after a legal paid attempt,not a diagnostic. Legendary means an existing authoritative source calls the subject legendary,or the Director has already established a campaign-significant widely remembered deed/history for that subject before the inquiry. The spell does not create that history,rank or artifact powers to make a newly named thing qualify. State one concrete lore question before casting. No roll. The Director privately gives up to three useful established facts directly answering it,drawn from the subject's actual history/record,including hidden unprotected facts where within this lore scope. Prefer central/material facts and record stable selection where several are equally responsive; repeating equivalent inquiries through another caster/reference does not rotate coequal secrets under unchanged circumstances. A genuinely different question,newly authenticated identifying evidence or materially changed records can support a new actual paid inquiry,without an arbitrary once-day cap. Facts may describe a true deed,origin in the mundane historical sense,former bearer,known operational limitation or an actual historical relationship,not just public flattery or a check bonus. State a tradition as a tradition when the record supports only that tradition,and distinguish uncertainty; do not upgrade a rumor to established truth. If necessary facts are absent,protected or subject identification truly fails,report Indeterminate for that portion without identifying the hidden cause. A meaningful independently readable portion can still be given. The result does not produce a complete item statblock,unwritten ability,magical formula,crafting credential,private current thoughts,complete secret roster,current remote coordinates or all facts about the subject. An actual operational limitation may be reported as one lore fact if established and unprotected,but no missing mechanics are invented. This is information,not a compulsory confession,truth guarantee about future outcomes,changed reputation or binding permission to use the subject. Actual information wards retain their source/classification scopes; a protected personal fact cannot be relabeled artifact history to bypass them. The inquiry discloses no cosmological facts that have not been separately established; this proposal authors no new such facts. The instantaneous result can be remembered and shared normally after the cast,but supplies no ongoing tracking,scrying,telepathy or automatic authentication of every later retelling. Copies/readied inquiries keep actual source costs and original question/result identities; replaying a result is not another selection from the hidden record.
